title: Mexico Viking
subtitle: A Viking's Memoir on Mexico's Environmental Challenges
author: Eric Gustafson
description: Mexico Viking follows Nils, a man born in Mexico with Scandinavian roots and a life shaped by two worlds. From Mexico's wetlands and arid deserts to Wyoming and Alaska, his journey unfolds through friendships, aviation, hunting adventures, unexpected encounters, decades of memories and even clairvoyance. But beneath the adventures lies a deeper passion: Mexico and its extraordinary natural heritage. Part memoir, part adventure, and part reflection on sustain-ervation, Mexico Viking is the story of a life lived between cultures—and of one man's enduring belief that Mexico can reclaim the best of its past while building a better future.

title: Joe and Running Bear
author: Eric Gustafson
description: A novel for young readers centered on outdoor survival and true adventure.

title: Laguna Flamingos
subtitle: A Groundbreaking Model for Sustainable Ecosystem Restoration
author: Eric Gustafson
publisher: Conservation Mexico, A.C. — funded by USFWS
description: One of the most successful and sustainable wildlife restoration projects, benefiting migratory waterfowl from Canada, the United States, and Mexico, as well as local communities.

title: The White Wing Dove in Northeast México
subtitle: La Paloma de Alas Blancas en el Noreste de México
author: Eric Gustafson
description: An examination of the present and future status of the White Winged Dove in northeastern Mexico.

title: Soto La Marina
subtitle: Laguna Flamingos
author: Eric Gustafson
description: A study of the Soto la Marina River watershed and its restoration needs — work that helped drive the construction of a treatment plant for raw sewage contaminating oysters, fisheries, and drinking water.

title: The Organization and Development of a Post Secondary Teaching Improvement Center in Mexico
author: Eric Gustafson
description: Written while alternating semesters between the University of Massachusetts and the Monterrey Institute of Technology, setting up the Center.

title: Mexico Monterrey, and You
author: Eric Gustafson
description: Cultural guidance for Canadians and Americans living in Monterrey, co-written with ASFM teachers as part of a Temple University Masters in Education course.

title: A Story of Success in Rural Mexico
author: Eric Gustafson
description: The turnaround of a money-losing ranch — 35% larger than Liechtenstein — into an ecosystem sustainably benefiting wildlife, the environment, and its inhabitants. Author wrote the preface.

author: Eric Gustafson
